reason: I've already installed Walnut, Money Manager and a habit tracker and dropped all of them within a few weeks, so I'm not paying for another one. At most I'd try the free version, and honestly one app for money, habits, health and food sounds cluttered to me.
objection: I never stick with these apps, and a brand new app from one developer with zero reviews asking to link my bank account makes me nervous.
would_change_my_mind: If I used the free version for a month without quitting and the auto bank sync actually showed me where my salary goes, then Rs 99 for the AI photo stuff might be worth it.
